moments.title: A history on the back
moments.text: This history, a bigger wordmark with a soft glow, and side flips that glide on iPhones.

moments.title: New menus
moments.text: New Sort and Tag menus, penguins that dance along with you, and the playing song's cover fills its row.

moments.title: Turn it by hand
moments.text: Grab the jukebox by its side and turn it round yourself. Plus a new Queen Moth and a fresher record clack.

moments.title: Side A, side B
moments.text: Countdown Island flips over to its slowed side B, an LED sign scrolls along the front, and the penguins can dance to the beat.

moments.title: Waves and lights
moments.text: Every song gets its own wave to scrub along, the lights and equalizer follow the music, and Jukebot's repair job gets an ending (and a secret).

moments.title: A real cabinet
moments.text: A proper jukebox cabinet that turns round in 3D, speakers that pulse to the beat, songs that blend into each other, and a face for Jukebot.

moments.title: Jukebot moves in
moments.text: Songs play on one after another, even with the screen off, and the jukebox turns round to show Jukebot: a little robot with bugs in his wiring for you to fix.

moments.title: Countdown Island and Exhale
moments.text: Countdown Island arrives with its slowed-down twin, then Exhale, and long tags scroll along like marquees.

moments.title: A lotta lot
moments.text: A whole catalog of older songs moves in, with sorting, a tag picker and 10-second skips.

moments.title: The overhaul
moments.text: Bigger cover art on every song, and three new ones: Runaway, Leafed and the Gallery remix.

moments.title: A new look
moments.text: Darker, starrier colors, a better fit on phones, and Dropoff.

moments.title: Made for phones
moments.text: Rebuilt to fit properly on a phone.

moments.title: Callout and Drift
moments.text: The first new songs since opening week: Callout, then Drift to start 2025.

moments.title: Penguins and covers
moments.text: The jukebox gets its look: two penguins keeping watch, a welcome note, cover art and Play buttons.

moments.title: The jukebox opens
moments.text: Four songs with plain players and no covers yet, a tag filter, and the frog quest badge.
